messages:
Alex T.: heads-up: ran access-lint on prod KMS keys this morning, scanner flagged svc-analytics-admin hitting a key with cross-account principal. paste of the CloudTrail-ish event below. cc @Maria K. @Devon R.
access-lint-bot: access-lint v2.4 -- finding: KMS_ALLOW_CROSS_ACCOUNT_USAGE for key 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh' count=3 severity=medium
Maria K.: can you paste the raw event or CloudTrail snippet? need source IP, role ARN and eventTime to triage
Alex T.: ```
CloudTrailEvent:
{
  "eventTime":"2026-03-20T18:02:12Z",
  "eventName":"Decrypt",
  "userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:sts::999888777666:assumed-role/svc-analytics-admin/eks-node"},
  "requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"},
  "sourceIPAddress":"52.24.11.73",
  "eventSource":"kms.amazonaws.com"
}
```
Devon R.: that assumed-role arn is from acct 999888777666 — svc-analytics-admin should be same-account only. looks like a cross-account trust was added at some point. @Maria can you pull the role trust policy?
Maria K.: running a quick get-role, returning AssumeRolePolicyDocument now. snippet: `{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:root"}}]}`
Alex T.: also saw STS chain entries and an external-id in the pipeline logs earlier, could be a third-party onboarding mistake
Priya S.: mitigation proposal: remove kms:Decrypt from svc-analytics-admin on that key and add condition `{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}` to key policy. I'll raise a short P0 change and roll to canary for the key in us-west-2.
Devon R.: :thumbsup: also propose we add an access-lint rule to flag Decrypt events when principal.account != key.account (suggested name: key-account-mismatch)
access-lint-bot: Rule request logged: #2345 - 'key-account-mismatch' created by Devon R.
Alex T.: I'll file SEC ticket with evidence and remediation snippets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-7921 — adding logs and recommended key policy change. tagging Maria for verification
Maria K.: thanks — will attest key ownership and run account-scoped scan across other keys this afternoon. will update SEC-7921 when done.
